18K views · 34 reactions | President Trump said Monday that the FBI is investigating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with a suspected Chinese government agent, but expressed confidence that the leader of the world's second-most-valuable company has nothing to worry about.
 
"I know the FBI is looking into it in terms of something else, and I think that he'll be in good shape," he told reporters during a White House briefing.
 
Mr. Huang, who has a close relationship with President Trump, acknowledged Sunday that he had an affair with a woman whom U.S. intelligence determined was working on behalf of Beijing, according to the New York Times.
 
The revelation raises questions about whether China may have gained access to Nvidia's cutting-edge chips, which are critical to AI development.
 
"I did speak to him today just to see if he's feeling all right," President Trump said. "He said he had absolutely no idea that the person in question was a spy."
